faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost?
faqs.a: It depends on size, pitch, material, project type and any additional roof components. As a guide, concrete tile roof systems start around £62 per square metre supply and installed before re-roof strip/disposal allowances. Ask me for a guided ballpark and I can break it down.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential full replacements take 2-4 working days from tear-off to final inspection, weather permitting.

faqs.q: How do I know if I need a repair or a full replacement?
faqs.a: If you have isolated cracked tiles or a flashing leak, a repair usually works. Widespread cracking, sagging, or a roof near the end of its life (25+ years for tiles) points to replacement. Our free inspection gives you a definite answer.
